IEC 100.name: Introduction to Social Implications of Information Technology
IEC 100.description: Critical perspectives on emerging information technologies, including data systems, artificial intelligence (algorithms), and security technologies.

IEC 200.name: A Critical Theory Perspective on Information Technology and Design
IEC 200.description: How designers shape systems affecting inequality and environmental issues, analyzing complex technical systems as layered architectures.

IEC 300.name: Socially Responsible Information Management
IEC 300.description: Organizational data practices through a social justice lens, covering information policies, storage, access, and disclosure.

IEC 320W.name: Information and Ethics
IEC 320W.description: Foundational concepts in information ethics, covering privacy and morality in distributed systems, with global dimensions. Writing Across the Curriculum.
